answer: Max-flow trust bottleneck resists sybils: the total trust a region receives from the honest seed is capped by the capacity of the cut it crosses — its attack edges — not by how densely members interlink. A sybil mass is an oasis reachable only through a thin channel, so however many fakes crowd behind it, the flow through those few edges stays jade-thin and splits among them all. They cannot widen the channel without forging genuine honest edges, so aggregate standing is glacier-frozen at the cut capacity. Precondition: attack edges stay few versus honest degree.
